"LOOP DRUM 1" AND "LOOP DRUM 2" SCRIPTS
---
These blocks make the drum sprite do things when it receives the "Loop Drum" broadcast.

One makes the chosen sound play forever on a loop, or until something (like another broadcast being received) stops it.

The other one changes the costumes so that the drum is animated forever on a loop, or until something (like another broadcast being received) stops it.

These are two separate scripts because we want them to run in parallel instead of in a sequence.
